d:
15 years passed since the siege of the Nazi Vampires survivors of the 3rd Reich, lead in the early 2000s by the Major, sieged London but ultimately failed thanks to the intervention of Alucard and Seras Victoria of the Hellsing Agency.

While Seras is enjoying her off-duty night, in present time, something sinister happens to her...

After you read the comic a first time (once the comic is completed), it is advised to read again, once Page 6 is reached, while listening to:

Yasushi Ishii - The World's Last Sagacious Period
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SlSDcZP5ss4

The comic is written with the music track being a BGM to it, with pages fitting the mood as the music track goes on as you read (from page 6 onwards to the end the scene lasts 4 minutes, same as the BGM).

You can find my and other's AI GEN comics here as well:
https://storinex.com/creator/ddark92
